releaseNotes:
• AirPods-Style Update Dialog: Redesigned with navbar liquid glass UI, bottom navigation bar insets, edge-to-edge window configuration, and prevented clipping
• Mini Player Seekbar Haptics & Liquid Bubble: Added tactile ticking haptic feedback during seeking and tap-and-hold, with organic liquid-connected time display floating above the pill
• Next Up Controls & Queue Styling: Translucent navbar edge glass UI with high-contrast text and icons optimized for both light and dark mode
• Lyrics & Next Up Toggle Pills: Specular frosted borders and crystal-clear contrast across light and dark mode
